positions.reasoning: Forced fix for two simultaneous hard breaches: cash at 0.59 EUR against a 150 EUR floor, and 7 open positions against a cap of 6 — this single exit clears both. SLB is the correct cut: -13.3% in 17 days, zero sponsorship across all eight notes, and its backdrop inverted (the confirmed USD leadership is refiners expanding cracks on FADING crude, the anti-thesis for oilfield services), while the disposal crystallises a securities-silo loss at no PFU cost with a 10-year carry-forward against unrealised gains in 4GLD.DE and ALV.DE.

Flagged as the next funding source, not sold today: flat at 219.34 vs 219.21 avg over 67 days with no analyst sponsorship, and yolo-sapiens (conviction 8) calls the chip day beta rather than leadership. But once the SLB exit clears the cash and position-count breaches, NVDA meets no stated trade condition — no originating analyst flip, no stop hit, and it sits well under the 400 cap — so selling it to pre-fund an idea I have not yet committed to would be discretionary churn.

hold_reasoning: Only one order this session by design. The SLB exit leaves ~225 EUR cash, of which just ~75 EUR is deployable above the 150 EUR floor — below the 250-400 sizing band, and a 1.25 EUR fee floor on 75 EUR is 1.7% round-trip, which no thesis on this board clears. So the highest-conviction idea, FRO (triple overlap: sharp-shooter-eur BUY 6, yolo-sapiens BUY 8, world BUY 7, all describing the same tanker/refiner margin expansion), is deliberately deferred to next week's fresh turnover budget and will be entered on confirmation above 55 rather than into the 52.21-55 churn. Separately, satoshi's alt-rotation note is discounted rather than acted on: it cites SOL holding 95 EUR and LINK reclaiming 10.20 EUR, but the verified store closes SOL-EUR at 88.5387 and LINK-EUR at 9.9255 — both below the note's own levels. I am flagging that discrepancy rather than reconciling it, and taking no BTC-EUR action on the strength of it; a crypto EUR cash-out would in any case trigger PFU 30% immediately on a +14.3% position.
